categories.name: Release A
categories.description: Represents the standard discharge outcome for admitted patients, contributing to avoiding post-discharge deterioration and measured against post-discharge ER return.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release A (id=17) as observed in the narrative sample (e.g., V0008, V0065).

categories.name: Release B

categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release B (id=18) as observed in the narrative sample (e.g., V0068, V0145).

categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release C (id=19) as observed in long-duration variants like V0710.
